# The Institute for Climate and Sustainable Growth

> A leading climate research and education institute at the University of Chicago advancing climate technology, policy, and sustainable development through interdisciplinary research and innovative academic programs.

The Institute for Climate and Sustainable Growth at UChicago conducts cutting-edge research on climate change, energy policy, and decarbonization while offering undergraduate and graduate education programs. The institute brings together world-class faculty, visiting scholars, and industry leaders to address global climate challenges through research, policy innovation, and talent development.

## Key Topics

- Climate and Sustainable Growth
- Climate Research
- Energy Policy
- Climate Technology
- Decarbonization

- Climate Systems Engineering
- Harris School of Public Policy
- Global Impact
